desktop.notes:
• Show on, per album: TV · Website · Screensaver · Wallpapers toggles on the album bar (and right-click › Show on) → albums.json "show". Right-click › Details…: Hebrew name / note, when (+ Hebrew), place.
• Publish (top bar): reads the Library's outputs.json, ticks the outputs whose albums changed since their last publish, runs their command (asks once before a new one), shows done / the error.
• Words on this computer: Ollama + Gemma 3 (12B on a big graphics card like an RTX 4090, 4B on an 8 GB laptop card or without one) write titles / stories EN + HE from Cullect's data + a small picture. Missing? One dialog offers the download (size, offline, nothing leaves the PC) with progress + Stop. AI menu: write missing words for the selection / this shoot or album / the whole Library, with n / total + Stop. No online AI and no API keys anywhere.
• Drag photos in from Explorer (files or folders): copied into <YYYY-MM> Added with a .pnfo (id from name + size + EXIF time, camera data from EXIF); already there = skipped.
